items.name: dga
items.title: Platform Code
items.description: Sets up Platform Code: the DGA style and tokens, Hugeicons, RTL, and the @dga registry in components.json.
items.docs: DGA style installed. Set <html dir="rtl" lang="ar"> for Arabic, and use data-theme="dark" or the .dark class for dark mode. Docs: https://dga.omqkhafi.dev/docs

items.name: dga-style
items.title: DGA style
items.description: DGA style: Base UI, Hugeicons, IBM Plex Sans Arabic, the cn helper and the cn-* component style map. Pulls in dga-tokens.
items.docs: DGA style installed. Set <html dir="rtl" lang="ar"> for Arabic, and use data-theme="dark" or the .dark class for dark mode. Docs: https://dga.omqkhafi.dev/docs

items.name: dga-tokens
items.title: DGA tokens
items.description: Every DGA design token as CSS variables: light and dark themes, responsive modes, the Tailwind v4 theme and the shadcn variable mapping. Install on its own to use the tokens without components.

:root.--primitive-font-family-display: var(--font-sans, "IBM Plex Sans Arabic"), system-ui, sans-serif
:root.--primitive-font-family-text: var(--font-sans, "IBM Plex Sans Arabic"), system-ui, sans-serif

items.name: utils
items.title: Utils
items.description: The cn helper, re-exported from the cn package (replaces clsx + tailwind-merge).

items.name: font-ibm-plex-sans-arabic
items.title: IBM Plex Sans Arabic
items.description: The DGA typeface for Arabic and Latin, weights 400 to 700.

items.name: spinner
items.title: Spinner
items.description: DGA Loading indicator: seven sizes, primary, neutral and on-colour.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: DGA Button on Base UI: primary, neutral, secondary, outline, subtle and transparent, destructive and on-colour, three sizes, icon-only and loading.

items.name: link
items.title: Link
items.description: DGA Link: primary, neutral and on-colour, two sizes, inline, external and disabled. Works with Next.js Link through the render prop.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: DGA Badge (from the design.dga.gov.sa CSS): seven colours and on-colour, filled or outlined, sm/md/lg, rounded and icon-only.

items.name: tag
items.title: Tag
items.description: DGA Tag and Status Tag: neutral, success, info, warning, error and on-colour; filled or outlined; xs/sm/md; rounded, icon-only and dismissible. Status Tag: subtle, inverted and ghost with a dot.

items.name: divider
items.title: Divider
items.description: DGA Divider on Base UI Separator: neutral, primary, alpha-white and white; horizontal or vertical.

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: DGA Avatar on Base UI: image, initials or icon, 24 to 120px, circle or square, optional ring; Avatar Group stacked or spaced.

items.name: featured-icon
items.title: Featured Icon
items.description: DGA Featured Icon (from the design.dga.gov.sa CSS): light, hard and outlined in six colours, sm to xl, square or circle.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: DGA Skeleton: rectangle, square, circle and line placeholders in the Figma sizes. Static with reduced motion.

items.name: field
items.title: Field
items.description: DGA Field on Base UI Field and Fieldset: label with required or optional marker, helper text, error with icon, horizontal layout for checkbox, radio and switch, grouping with legend.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: DGA Text Input on Base UI Input: md 32px and lg 40px, default, lighter and darker fills, prefix and suffix, hover, focus, read-only, disabled and error.

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: DGA Textarea on Base UI Field: default, lighter and darker fills, resizable, hover, focus, read-only, disabled and error.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: DGA Checkbox on Base UI: primary and neutral, 16, 20 and 24px, checked, indeterminate, read-only, disabled and error.

items.name: radio
items.title: Radio
items.description: DGA Radio and Radio Group on Base UI: primary and neutral, selected, read-only, disabled and error, arrow-key navigation.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: DGA Switch on Base UI: 48x24px, optional check icon, hover, focus, read-only, disabled and error. Moves on the logical axis in RTL.

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: DGA Slider on Base UI Slider: a single value or a range, small and medium, label, helper text, value readout and error. The fill and arrow keys follow the page direction.

items.name: input-otp
items.title: Input OTP
items.description: Platform Code extension on Base UI OTP Field: a one-time code in separate Input boxes with separators, paste and Arabic-Indic digit input. The boxes always run left to right.

items.name: toggle
items.title: Toggle
items.description: Platform Code extension on Base UI Toggle: a two-state button in the DGA Button outline, subtle, transparent and secondary styles.

items.name: toggle-group
items.title: Toggle Group
items.description: Platform Code extension on Base UI Toggle Group: attached or spaced toggles, single or multiple, horizontal or vertical, with arrow keys that follow the direction.

items.name: input-group
items.title: Input Group
items.description: Platform Code extension: the DGA Input box with addons (prefix, icon, unit, Kbd, button) at either end.

items.name: button-group
items.title: Button Group
items.description: Platform Code extension: related DGA Buttons joined into one block with shared edges, a text segment and a separator, horizontal or vertical.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: DGA Dropdown Input on Base UI Select: md and lg, default, lighter and darker fills, grouped options, check mark on the chosen option, hover, open, read-only, disabled and error.

items.name: number-input
items.title: Number Input
items.description: DGA Number Input on Base UI Number Field: left-to-right isolated digits, Arabic-Indic digit input normalised to Western, - and + buttons on the logical sides, min, max and step.

items.name: search-box
items.title: Search Box
items.description: DGA Search Box on Base UI Input: search icon on the start side, clear button on the end side, md and lg, Escape clears.

items.name: file-upload
items.title: File Upload
items.description: DGA File Upload: keyboard-accessible drag-and-drop zone, file list with remove, progress and error states, type, size and count validation, Arabic file names.

items.name: direction
items.title: Direction
items.description: useDocumentDirection and AutoDirection: tells Base UI which way the page reads (the dir attribute of html), so arrow keys, submenus and tooltips follow RTL.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: DGA Modal on Base UI Dialog: sm, md and lg, a close button, header, body and footer. Focus is trapped and returns to the trigger, Escape closes it.

items.name: drawer
items.title: Drawer
items.description: DGA Slideout Menu on Base UI Drawer: slides in from the start, end, top or bottom (start and end flip in RTL), white or gray, closes by swipe.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: DGA Tooltip and Help Icon on Base UI Tooltip: light and dark, optional title, a beak, placement that mirrors in RTL; shows on hover and keyboard focus.

items.name: menu
items.title: Menu
items.description: DGA Menu on Base UI Menu: items with icons and trailing text, checkbox and radio items, groups, separators and submenus that mirror in RTL. Roving focus with arrow keys.

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: Platform Code extension (not DGA). Popover on Base UI Popover: a panel that opens from a button, on the DGA Menu surface with an optional Tooltip beak, title, description, close button, and sides that mirror in RTL.

items.name: hover-card
items.title: Hover Card
items.description: Platform Code extension (not DGA). Hover Card on Base UI Preview Card: a preview that opens when a link is hovered or focused, on the DGA Menu surface; hoverable and dismissible.

items.name: alert-dialog
items.title: Alert Dialog
items.description: Platform Code extension (not DGA). Alert Dialog on Base UI Alert Dialog, styled as the DGA Dialog: role alertdialog, focus starts on Cancel, no dismissal by clicking outside, destructive action.

items.name: context-menu
items.title: Context Menu
items.description: Platform Code extension (not DGA). Context Menu on Base UI Context Menu with the DGA Menu items: right-click, long-press, Shift+F10 and the Menu key, submenus that mirror in RTL.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: DGA Tabs on Base UI Tabs: horizontal and vertical, sm, md and lg, with icons, a divider and flush. Arrow keys follow the page direction.

items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: DGA Accordion on Base UI Accordion: sm, md and lg, leading or trailing chevron, flush, single or multiple open.

items.name: content-switcher
items.title: Content Switcher
items.description: DGA Content Switcher on Base UI Toggle Group: two to four options, sm, md and lg, and on-colour. One option is always chosen.

items.name: toast
items.title: Toast
items.description: DGA Notification Toast on Base UI Toast: neutral, info, success, warning and error, an action and a close button. Announced to screen readers, swipe to dismiss, bottom end of the screen.

items.name: notification
items.title: Notification
items.description: DGA Notification: a full-width banner in five kinds, with a lead-in, an action and a close button. Announced as a live region.

items.name: inline-alert
items.title: Inline Alert
items.description: DGA Inline Alert: five kinds on a white or tinted fill, a title, text, up to two actions and a close button. Announced as a live region.

items.name: breadcrumb
items.title: Breadcrumb
items.description: DGA Breadcrumb: the path to the current page, folded behind an ellipsis button above five levels and on narrow screens. The separator mirrors in RTL.

items.name: pagination
items.title: Pagination
items.description: DGA Pagination: previous, next, page numbers with ellipsis, sm, md and lg, buttons or links, and a compact form on narrow screens. Arrows mirror in RTL.

items.name: table-of-contents
items.title: Table of Contents
items.description: DGA Table of Content: links to the sections of a page with three levels, the section being read highlighted, and arrow-key navigation.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: DGA Card on Base UI Collapsible: shadow, stroke or none, three sizes, media, actions, a clickable-card link pattern, expandable and selectable cards.

items.name: list
items.title: List
items.description: DGA List and Structured List: ordered, unordered and icon lists in primary, neutral and on-colour, two levels, and selectable structured rows.

items.name: table
items.title: Table
items.description: DGA Table: a semantic table with header, striped rows, dividers, compact and contained, sortable and filter heading buttons, and sideways scrolling.

items.name: data-table
items.title: Data Table
items.description: A Table with sorting, filtering, row selection, pagination, loading and empty states, built on TanStack Table, the DGA Table and the DGA Pagination.

items.name: rating
items.title: Rating
items.description: DGA Rating on Base UI Radio Group: five stars, sm, md and lg, gold or brand, interactive with arrow keys or read-only.

items.name: progress
items.title: Progress
items.description: DGA Progress Bar on Base UI Progress: linear and circular, determinate and indeterminate, primary and neutral, success and error.

items.name: stepper
items.title: Stepper
items.description: DGA Progress Indicator and Radial Stepper: horizontal and vertical steps in completed, current, upcoming and error states, with a compact ring on narrow screens.

items.name: header
items.title: Header
items.description: DGA Nav Header: logo, main navigation with sub-menus on the DGA Menu, actions, search, language and user slots, a skip link and aria-current. Below lg the navigation moves into the DGA Drawer.

items.name: footer
items.title: Footer
items.description: DGA Footer: logos, description, social links, link columns that fold into the DGA Accordion on mobile, contact, app badges, and a legal and copyright row. Default or dark green.

items.name: second-nav
items.title: Second Nav
items.description: DGA Second Nav Header: a 40px strip above the header with contextual items and actions, gray or primary, that scrolls sideways on narrow screens.

items.name: date-picker
items.title: Date Picker
items.description: DGA Date Picker: a standalone Calendar and a field with a popup calendar. Gregorian and Hijri (Umm al-Qura, from Intl), single date and range, min, max, disabled dates, dual-month view, quick options and a confirm step. Full keyboard support.

items.name: carousel
items.title: Carousel
items.description: DGA Carousel: slides with previous and next, dots, autoplay with a pause button that respects reduced motion, swipe, arrow keys, and the slide order of the page direction.

items.name: filtration
items.title: Filtration
items.description: DGA Filtration: a filter panel of checkbox, radio, select, input and range groups, applied filters as removable Tags, clear all and a result count. Below lg the panel opens in the DGA Drawer.

items.name: combobox
items.title: Combobox
items.description: Platform Code extension (not in DGA) on Base UI Combobox: a searchable select with the DGA Input box and Select list. Single, multiple with removable chips, groups, creatable, async loading, clear button, Arabic-aware search.

items.name: command
items.title: Command
items.description: Platform Code extension (not in DGA) on Base UI Autocomplete, no cmdk: a Search Box over a Menu-style list of actions with groups, icons and shortcuts, and a CommandDialog palette. Arrow keys, Enter runs the action, Arabic-aware search.

items.name: digital-stamp
items.title: Digital Stamp
items.description: DGA Digital Stamp: the official-site strip with a disclosure panel that explains how to check the domain (gov.sa, edu.sa and the rest), https and registration. Goes in the Header's stamp slot.
